_comment: Story locations pinned to real Lincoln buildings (OpenStreetMap, ODbL).
Pinned by OSM element id, NEVER resolved by name at runtime: OSM already
has Kimani's shop tagged under a previous occupant ('Mankind'), and an
upstream rename must not be able to break mission one.
lat/lon is the fallback the tiler uses if an 22id is deleted upstream.
Anchor 0 is the building JD Sports occupies in the real world. The
BUILDING is the anchor; the in-game business is Trap Made It, and the real
retailer's trading name is deliberately not used (D-05, D-W01).
`kind` is still 'chapter' here. D-W01 requires it to stop representing
Chapter 1, but that is a gameplay change with content and mission
consequences, and WORLD-V01 is a rendering package. Left for the package
that moves THE COME UP somewhere else.

anchors.name: LINCOLN PRISON
anchors.sub: Nobody walks in here by choice.
